gaps.title: Selection and execution share an ability-button surface
gaps.observed: Mekan, Jali and Gracus dispatch immediately; other actions stage choices. The same board choice control calls activateAbility and closes.
gaps.required: Every action declares its commit behavior. Resource spending, public revelation and token creation must show a concrete target/result and an unmistakable execute control; selecting a source must never be mistaken for executing it.

gaps.title: Implicit payment recipient
gaps.observed: Stockbroker's Gloves takes the first selected payment card. The instruction says Forum payment +1 and does not identify the recipient.
gaps.required: Explicitly select and mark the recipient, show that card’s printed contribution plus payment bonus, and invalidate the choice if it leaves the payment set.

gaps.title: Incomplete direct-effect events and expiry evidence
gaps.observed: Watane/Katana modify temporary bonus and notes but emit only ability/source. Focus/Polea omit target IDs. Turn cleanup deletes bonuses without per-effect expiry receipts.
gaps.required: Record source instance, permitted target reference, value domain, before/delta/after, resource change, duration, consumption/replacement and priority. Sanitize each recipient projection.

gaps.title: Printed value shown without current modifiers
gaps.observed: Watane + Katana gives a printed 5 a stored +4; normalized hand and inspection still report 5. Combat aggregates and printed card values are separate but the card preview does not explain them.
gaps.required: Label printed, current attack/block, payment contribution and required cost separately. Show each effect contribution, replacement and expiry. Never imply value is guaranteed damage.

gaps.title: Legal target owner is lost in rendered lane enablement
gaps.observed: A Focus target in own lane 0 also enables opponent lane 0. The chosen own target is not rendered as selected.
gaps.required: Preserve owner, zone, instance and lane through eligibility, selected state, preview, pointer controls and accessibility controls.

gaps.title: Several ability families have no dedicated feedback
gaps.observed: ability.used, Jali Revenants/formation and Indela omen events have no dedicated callout/cadence route. A Jali buff formats as Match state updated. Combat/payment history has useful calculation receipts already.
gaps.required: Persist named source→target effects, resources, pending triggers, reveal/reorder results and ending conditions in state/inspection/history independent of animation and sound.

gaps.title: Trigger progress and unavailable reasons are incomplete
gaps.observed: Board cards distinguish Passive, Ready, Selected and Unavailable, but automatic vs continuous effects share Passive. New faction options disappear when unavailable, and no general per-trigger progress model exists.
gaps.required: Separate always active, automatic trigger, readied effect and optional activation. Display counters, next qualifying condition, remaining uses and specific unavailable reasons without leaking hidden knowledge.

gaps.title: Mekan/Jali activation leaves stale pass markers
gaps.observed: These separate dispatch branches bypass the reset used by Focus/Polea. Monti then pass can close a priority round after the opponent’s old pass.
gaps.required: Implement the response policy consistently and display priority retained/transferred, pass reset and provisional/resolved state. Gracus explicitly transfers priority and must retain that distinct behavior.

gaps.title: Cancellation and uncertain acknowledgement need durable explanations
gaps.observed: Selections clear on snapshot changes/disconnect and input locks during acknowledgement. Notices exist, but expiry/target invalidation lacks a durable reason. Unknown command status is represented as rejected after resync is attempted.
gaps.required: Distinguish rejected with no spend, accepted with spend, cancelled before submit, and unresolved acknowledgement. Do not assert nothing was spent until the authoritative command outcome is known.

gaps.title: Privacy and presentation qualification remains open
gaps.observed: Basho is publicly projected and Acama peek content is hidden from opponent/spectator in probes. This does not qualify every event, label, art, history, replay and reconnect path.
gaps.required: Test each ability for owner/opponent/spectator, including DOM labels and disabled reasons, with sound off, reduced motion, fast AI and missed animation.
